Six clients with private data train a sh.zh:
六个持有私有数据的客户端共同训练一个共享分类器，
          全程不向服务器发送数据。观察 FedAvg 在 IID 客户端上成功、
          在非 IID 客户端上崩溃；切换到 FedProx 看它如何恢复。
          随后是隐私与安全技术栈（安全聚合、差分隐私）。
Six clients with private data train a sh.src:
Six clients with private data train a shared classifier
          without ever sending the data to a server. Watch FedAvg
          succeed on IID clients and collapse on non-IID ones; flip
          to FedProx and watch it recover. Then the privacy + security
          stack (secure aggregation, differential privacy).

@@T0@@~20 min@@T1@@\n @@T2@@Dis.zh:
@@T0@@约 20 分钟@@T1@@
          @@T2@@分布式机器学习 · 隐私 · FedAvg@@T3@@

Data lives on $K$ clients (phones, hospi.zh:
数据存于 $K$ 个客户端之上（手机、医院、边缘设备、
          传感器网络）。每个客户端持有一个不愿共享的私有数据集
          $\mathcal{D}_k$。一台中心服务器协调共享模型 $\theta$ 的训练。每一轮：
Data lives on $K$ clients (phones, hospi.src:
Data lives on $K$ clients (phones, hospitals, edge devices,
          sensor networks). Each client has a private dataset
          $\mathcal{D}_k$ it will not share. A central server
          coordinates training of a shared model $\theta$. Each round:

Server sends $\\theta$ to a random sampl.zh: 服务器把 $\theta$ 发送给随机抽取的一部分客户端。
Server sends $\\theta$ to a random sampl.src: Server sends $\theta$ to a random sample of clients.

Each client runs $E$ local epochs of SGD.zh: 每个客户端在其数据上运行 $E$ 个本地 SGD 轮次。
Each client runs $E$ local epochs of SGD.src: Each client runs $E$ local epochs of SGD on its data.

FedAvg is one of the most cited DL paper.zh:
FedAvg 是这十年被引用最多的深度学习论文之一，
          也是最脆弱的方法之一。当客户端数据集为 IID（对全局数据集的随机划分）时，
          它表现极佳；而当它们并非如此时（生产中大多数情况即是如此），
          它便崩溃。
FedAvg is one of the most cited DL paper.src:
FedAvg is one of the most cited DL papers of the decade and
          one of the brittlest. It works beautifully when client
          datasets are IID (random partition of a global dataset);
          it collapses when they aren't (which is most of the time
          in production).

FedAvg vs FedProx — see them break and h.zh: FedAvg 与 FedProx——观察它们如何崩溃与修复
FedAvg vs FedProx — see them break and h.src: FedAvg vs FedProx — see them break and heal

Six clients, three-class 2-D classificat.zh:
六个客户端，三分类的二维分类问题。非 IID 滑块控制每个客户端
          标签分布的偏斜程度。取 0 时，每个客户端看到大致均匀的各类别；
          取 1 时，每个客户端只看到一两个类别。FedProx
          （Li et al.，2020）在每个客户端的本地目标中增加一个近端项
          $\frac{\mu}{2}\|\theta_k -
          \theta\|^2$，从而温和地把本地更新拉回全局模型。
Six clients, three-class 2-D classificat.src:
Six clients, three-class 2-D classification. The non-IID
          slider controls how skewed each client's label distribution
          is. At 0, every client sees roughly uniform classes; at 1,
          each client sees only one or two classes. FedProx
          (Li et al., 2020) adds a proximal term $\frac{\mu}{2}\|\theta_k -
          \theta\|^2$ to each client's local objective, gently
          pulling local updates back toward the global model.

Global classifier on test data.zh: 测试数据上的全局分类器

@@T0@@What to watch.@@T1@@\n Wi.zh:
@@T0@@观察要点。@@T1@@
          当非 IID 的 α 接近 0 时，FedAvg 在约 10 轮内收敛。
          把 α 推向 1，FedAvg 会@@T2@@震荡@@T3@@甚至发散——
          每个客户端的本地 SGD 都过拟合于它自己的类别，
          于是平均值反而比任何客户端的本地模型都差。切换到
          FedProx；近端项抑制了漂移，准确率重新攀升。
@@T0@@What to watch.@@T1@@\n Wi.src: What to watch. With non-IID α near 0, FedAvg converges within ~10 rounds. Push α to 1 and FedAvg oscillates or diverges — each client's local SGD overfits to its own classes and the average ends up worse than any client's local model. Switch to FedProx; the proximal term clips drift and accuracy climbs again.

FedAvg by itself isn't private. Sharing.zh:
FedAvg 本身并不具备隐私性。共享梯度会泄漏信息；
          重构攻击（Zhu et al.，2019）能够从单个客户端的更新中
          还原出原始图像。三层机制可以解决这一问题：
FedAvg by itself isn't private. Sharing.src:
FedAvg by itself isn't private. Sharing gradients leaks
          information; reconstruction attacks (Zhu et al., 2019)
          can recover original images from a single client update.
          Three layers fix this:

@@T0@@Secure aggregation@@T1@@ (Bonawitz.zh:
@@T0@@安全聚合@@T1@@（Bonawitz et al.，
            2017）。这是一种密码学协议，使服务器只能看到@@T2@@总和@@T3@@
            $\sum_k \theta_k$，而看不到各个单独的更新。
            在 t-诚实但好奇的威胁模型下具有信息论意义上的安全性。
@@T0@@Secure aggregation@@T1@@ (Bonawitz.src: Secure aggregation (Bonawitz et al., 2017). Cryptographic protocol so the server only sees the sum $\sum_k \theta_k$, not individual updates. Information-theoretically secure under a t-honest-but-curious threat model.

@@T0@@Differential privacy@@T1@@ (DP-Fed.zh:
@@T0@@差分隐私@@T1@@（DP-FedAvg，Abadi
            et al.，2016）。每个客户端把其更新裁剪到有界范数，
            并加入高斯噪声；全局模型满足 $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-差分隐私。
            在准确率与隐私预算之间权衡。
@@T0@@Differential privacy@@T1@@ (DP-Fed.src: Differential privacy (DP-FedAvg, Abadi et al., 2016). Each client clips its update to a bounded norm and adds Gaussian noise; the global model satisfies $(\varepsilon, \delta)$-DP. Trade accuracy against privacy budget.

@@T0@@Homomorphic encryption / TEE.@@T1@.zh:
@@T0@@同态加密 / TEE。@@T1@@
            服务器在加密数值上计算平均值；或运行于
            可信执行环境（Intel SGX、AMD SEV）之中。
            开销更重，用于受监管的行业。
@@T0@@Homomorphic encryption / TEE.@@T1@.src: Homomorphic encryption / TEE. The server computes the average on encrypted values; or runs in a Trusted Execution Environment (Intel SGX, AMD SEV). Heavier, used in regulated industries.

Practical setups in 2026: @@T0@@FedML@@T.zh:
2026 年的实用方案：@@T0@@FedML@@T1@@、
          @@T2@@Flower@@T3@@、@@T4@@NVFlare@@T5@@、
          @@T6@@OpenFL@@T7@@ 都把 FedAvg/FedProx/SCAFFOLD、
          安全聚合与 DP-SGD 作为即插即用组件提供。
Practical setups in 2026: @@T0@@FedML@@T.src: Practical setups in 2026: FedML, Flower, NVFlare, OpenFL all ship FedAvg/FedProx/SCAFFOLD, secure aggregation, and DP-SGD as drop-in components.

Algorithm zoo — what to use when.zh: 算法图谱——何时用哪一种
Algorithm zoo — what to use when.src: Algorithm zoo — what to use when

IID-ish clients, baseline.zh: 近似 IID 的客户端，作为基线

+ proximal term on client objective.zh: 在客户端目标上增加近端项

Control variates to cancel client drift.zh: 用控制变量抵消客户端漂移
Control variates to cancel client drift.src: Control variates to cancel client drift

Distillation on a server-side public set.zh: 在服务器端公开集上做蒸馏
Distillation on a server-side public set.src: Distillation on a server-side public set

Keep BatchNorm stats local, average ever.zh: 让 BatchNorm 统计量保持本地，其余全部平均
Keep BatchNorm stats local, average ever.src: Keep BatchNorm stats local, average everything else

Image clients with different statistics.zh: 统计分布各异的图像客户端

Per-client head, global trunk.zh: 各客户端独立头部，共享全局主干

Per-client distribution drift; medical,.zh: 各客户端分布漂移；医疗、移动端键盘
Per-client distribution drift; medical,.src: Per-client distribution drift; medical, mobile keyboards

Mixture-of-experts where each expert is.zh: 每个专家都位于本地的专家混合结构
Mixture-of-experts where each expert is.src: Mixture-of-experts where each expert is local

Strongly heterogeneous clients; 2024+.zh: 强异构客户端；2024 年之后

@@T0@@Stragglers.@@T1@@ One slow client.zh:
@@T0@@掉队者。@@T1@@ 一个缓慢的客户端会阻塞每一轮。
            标准做法是：每轮丢弃最慢的 20%；或采用
            诸如 FedBuff 之类的异步变体。
@@T0@@Stragglers.@@T1@@ One slow client.src: Stragglers. One slow client blocks every round. Standard fix: drop the slowest 20% per round; use asynchronous variants like FedBuff.

@@T0@@Heterogeneous compute.@@T1@@ A pho.zh:
@@T0@@算力异构。@@T1@@ 手机客户端无法在服务器等待的时间内
            跑完 10 个轮次。可改用 FedProx（对 E 不敏感），
            或为每个客户端设定本地步数预算。
@@T0@@Heterogeneous compute.@@T1@@ A pho.src: Heterogeneous compute. A phone client can't run 10 epochs in the time the server waits. Use FedProx (insensitive to E) or per-client local-step budgets.

@@T0@@Catastrophic forgetting.@@T1@@ If.zh:
@@T0@@灾难性遗忘。@@T1@@ 若某个客户端带着新类别较晚加入，
            全局模型可能丢失旧类别。FedDF / 回放缓冲区 / 持续联邦学习的
            论文对此有所研究。
@@T0@@Catastrophic forgetting.@@T1@@ If.src: Catastrophic forgetting. If a client joins late with a new class, the global model can lose old classes. FedDF / replay buffers / continual-FL papers address this.

@@T0@@Reconstruction attacks.@@T1@@ Grad.zh:
@@T0@@重构攻击。@@T1@@ 梯度会泄漏数据。
            对任何隐私敏感的部署，务必将 FedAvg 与安全聚合、差分隐私
            结合使用。
@@T0@@Reconstruction attacks.@@T1@@ Grad.src: Reconstruction attacks. Gradients reveal data. Always combine FedAvg with secure aggregation and DP for any privacy-sensitive deployment.

@@T0@@Free-rider / Byzantine clients.@@T.zh:
@@T0@@搭便车 / 拜占庭客户端。@@T1@@ 恶意客户端
            可以污染模型。鲁棒聚合（Krum、中位数、截尾均值）
            可抵御有界比例的恶意方；密码学可验证聚合则更进一层。
@@T0@@Free-rider / Byzantine clients.@@T.src: Free-rider / Byzantine clients. A malicious client can poison the model. Robust aggregation (Krum, median, trimmed mean) defends against a bounded fraction; cryptographic verifiable aggregation goes further.

@@T0@@Evaluation.@@T1@@ Global accuracy.zh:
@@T0@@评估。@@T1@@ 全局准确率会掩盖各客户端之间的差距。
            务必同时报告最差客户端与第 10 百分位的准确率。
@@T0@@Evaluation.@@T1@@ Global accuracy.src: Evaluation. Global accuracy hides per-client disparity. Always report worst-client and 10th-percentile accuracy too.

@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Feder.zh:
@@T0@@口号。@@T1@@
          当客户端之间@@T2@@略有@@T3@@差异时，联邦学习行之有效；
          当它们差异@@T4@@很大@@T5@@时则会崩溃；处于二者之间时需要
          FedProx / SCAFFOLD / 个性化变体；而若数据是私有的，
          则始终需要隐私原语。算法部分所占甚小；
          系统与威胁模型部分才是主角。
@@T0@@The slogan.@@T1@@\n Feder.src: The slogan. Federated learning works when clients differ a little; collapses when they differ a lot; needs FedProx / SCAFFOLD / personalised variants in the middle; and always needs privacy primitives if the data is private. The algorithmic part is small; the systems and threat-model parts dominate.

meta.title: 联邦学习：逐轮理解
meta.tagline: 在不共享数据的多个客户端上训练模型——并观察非 IID 漂移如何击垮 FedAvg
meta.summary: 六个具有不同本地标签分布的客户端，通过 FedAvg 训练一个共享分类器。滑动非 IID 强度滑块，观察全局准确率如何崩溃；切换到 FedProx 看它如何稳定下来。附带通信轮次-准确率曲线、各客户端权重漂移图，以及安全聚合与差分隐私的说明。
highlights: 六个客户端，各具非 IID 标签偏斜；在浏览器中实时运行 FedAvg 各轮。
非 IID 滑块：IID → 标签偏斜 → 每客户端单一类别；观察全局准确率的失效。
FedProx 与 FedAvg 切换：近端项驯服了非 IID 客户端上的漂移。
通信轮次-准确率曲线 + 各客户端权重漂移柱状图。
